name: PRIMA: proof of existence with Bitcoin timestamps
description: PRIMA generates verifiable evidence of existence and integrity for a digital file: a canonical manifest, an OpenTimestamps proof anchored in the Bitcoin blockchain, and a certificate package that can be verified independently, without the platform, years later. It is not an intellectual property registry and does not prove authorship. Developed following FAIR principles (FAIR4RS): a public JSON Schema for the manifest, an independent verifier script, JSON-LD (schema.org) metadata, a static OpenAPI description of the public API, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude and other LLM agents.
applicationCategory: Research software, digital evidence, proof of existence

referencePublication.text: Gagliano, Antonio (2026). PRIMA: proof of existence with Bitcoin timestamps (v1.0.0). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23512705
